title: Something Deeply Hidden | Sean Carroll | Talks at Google
summary: Sean Carroll's Talks at Google presentation of his book Something Deeply Hidden. He gives an accessible introduction to quantum mechanics and argues for the many-worlds interpretation and the emergence of spacetime.
why: Recommended as an approachable case that the Everett (many-worlds) interpretation is the simplest reading of quantum mechanics.

quote.text: I'd recommend watching this talk by Sean Carroll
